fact: In June 2024 the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance acquired full ownership and source code rights to the EDRMS (eDocs+) and in June 2025 trained government technical officers to give first- and second-line support and onboard entities, so the government has internal expertise to manage it.
title: Driving Digital Transformation through EDRMS Trainer Program
publisher: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance
